7) No inference used:
- All fields matched explicitly in text; none were guessed. Numeric values converted to numeric form preserving decimals.

Potential ambiguities considered:
- Confirmed "Unsere USt.-ID-Nr." is sender VAT (not customer's). Customer USt.-ID ("Ihre USt.-ID-Nr.") is ATU22642807 but schema asks Sender.VatId, so used ATU58198337.
- VAT rate formatted "10,00 %" -> returned as 10 per rule to omit percent sign.

All extracted fields are present and supported by exact text locations above.
